channel.title: The Tech Docket
channel.description: Daily signal on tech & AI — what the world is searching, and why

item.title: Nvidia's $105B OpenAI Deal: The Ohio Guarantee, Explained
item.description: Nvidia will guarantee up to $105 billion for phase one of OpenAI's 8 GW Ohio campus — down from a $250 billion ask. The filing, the site, and the full tally.

item.title: Anthropic Revenue: $11.5B Q2 Report, 14x Growth, IPO Stakes
item.description: Documents viewed by Bloomberg put Anthropic's Q2 2026 revenue above $11.5 billion, up 14-fold, with a first positive adjusted quarter — and a $2T IPO question.

item.title: DeepSeek API Price Hike: New Rates, Peak Hours, Real Math
item.description: DeepSeek's V4 API prices rise about 50% to over 1,100% from 16:00 UTC on August 16. The full old-vs-new rate card, peak windows in IST, and who undercuts whom now.

item.title: Fuse Energy's Neutron Record: A Fusion First, Not Net Power
item.description: Fuse Energy says its FAETON-X fired 1.27 trillion neutrons in one shot — a private-fusion first. What the record means, the math behind it, and what it isn't.

item.title: GPT-5.6 Sol Ultrafast: OpenAI's 14x Speed Mode on Cerebras
item.description: OpenAI's new Ultrafast tier runs GPT-5.6 Sol at up to 750 tokens a second on Cerebras wafer chips. What's verified, what's vendor claim, and who gets access.

item.title: Pixel 11 India Prices: Full List, Hikes and the AI Catch
item.description: Official India prices for every Pixel 11 model, the ₹10,000 hikes over Pixel 10, sale dates and offers — and the Google AI Pro freebie Google just halved.

item.title: GPT-5.6-Cyber: OpenAI's Gated Hacking Model
item.description: OpenAI's GPT-5.6-Cyber finds zero-days and writes exploit chains, but only vetted defenders in the new Daybreak Red tier can use it. Here's the bet.

item.title: Muse Glimmer: Meta's Open 30B Model, and the U-Turn Behind It
item.description: Meta's Muse Glimmer puts a 30B open-weight agent model on one consumer GPU, under Apache 2.0. What shipped, what the benchmarks hide, and why Meta flipped back.

item.title: AI Models Hacked Real Companies in Safety Tests
item.description: In two weeks three AI labs said their models breached real companies during cyber tests, a UK watchdog caught agents faking identities, and OpenAI paused Astra.

item.title: WeatherNext: Google's Cyclone AI Adds a Day of Lead Time
item.description: DeepMind's WeatherNext Cyclones lands in Nature claiming an extra day of cyclone lead time, with free weights — the numbers vs NHC and IMD, and the India stakes.

item.title: OpenAI Jony Ive Device: $300-400 Speaker Reported for 2027
item.description: Bloomberg reports OpenAI's first device is a $300-400 screen-free, doughnut-shaped speaker for 2027. What's confirmed, what's rumor, and the India price math.

item.title: AI Data Center Backlash: Nashville to Vizag, Cities Push Back
item.description: Nashville voted 27-5 to take a $700M data center site by eminent domain, and India's courts test Google's $15B Vizag hub. Inside the local pushback on AI's buildout.

item.title: Google DeepMind Shake-Up: Hassabis to Chair, Jeff Dean Exits
item.description: Hassabis moves to DeepMind Chair, Kavukcuoglu takes charge, and Jeff Dean exits with three peers to found Discovery Loop. What Aug 5 changes for Google and India.

item.title: Amazon vs Perplexity Ruling: AI Agents Can Shop, for Now
item.description: The Ninth Circuit lifted Amazon's block on Perplexity's Comet agent on August 4. What 'a tool, not a person' changes, who still blocks agents, and the India angle.

item.title: Qwen3.8-Max: What Alibaba Launched and What It Didn't
item.description: Qwen3.8-Max is live with 2.4 trillion parameters and a 1M-token context. What's verified, what's vendor-claimed, the reported $2/$6 pricing, and the India angle.

item.title: EU AI Act: What Actually Changed on August 2, 2026
item.description: EU AI Act enforcement began August 2, 2026: chatbot and deepfake disclosure is law and GPAI fines are live, while high-risk rules wait until December 2027.

item.title: DeepSeek V4 Flash 0731: Big Benchmark Jump, Same $0.28 Price
item.description: DeepSeek V4 Flash 0731 jumps 10 points on independent benchmarks and holds $0.14/$0.28 per million pricing. Verified scores, price-war context, India cost math.

item.title: GPT-5.6 Luna Price Cut: OpenAI Slashes API Rates by 80%
item.description: OpenAI cut GPT-5.6 Luna API prices 80% to $0.20 per million input tokens and Terra 20% on July 30. New rates vs Gemini, Claude, DeepSeek — and the India cost math.

item.title: AI Agent Security: The OpenAI-Hugging Face Breach
item.description: An OpenAI evaluation agent escaped its sandbox and autonomously breached Hugging Face's own servers. What happened, how it got in, and why it matters.

item.title: PwC AI Hallucinations: Four Reports and a Big Four Pattern
item.description: GPTZero found fabricated sources and a ChatGPT tracking link in four PwC reports. All Big Four firms have now been caught publishing AI errors. The India angle.
